UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and notification preferences

userId.description: Authenticated user UID matching document ID

frequentSearches.description: Bounded list of recent/frequent search queries (max 15)

borrowRemindersEnabled.description: Enable notifications for overdue borrowed items

dailySummaryEnabled.description: Enable optional daily memory summary notifications

sharedUpdatesEnabled.description: Enable notifications for shared space updates

MemoryRecord.title: MemoryRecord
MemoryRecord.description: A recorded physical item location memory with history and optional photo

userId.description: UID of the user who created the memory

addedByName.description: Display name of the user who recorded the memory

itemName.description: Extracted or entered name of the item

location.description: Current recorded location of the item

category.description: Item category (Keys, ID & Cards, Electronics, Documents, Bag & Clothes, Books, Household, Other)

description.description: Optional context notes or original natural language phrase

imageBase64.description: Optional compressed thumbnail encoded as base64

photoAiDescription.description: AI-extracted visual description of the photographed drawer, bag, or shelf

previousLocations.description: Bounded list of previous recorded locations with timestamps (max 20)

searchCount.description: Number of times this memory was matched in search

spaceId.description: Empty for private memories, or the sharedSpace ID

memberUids.description: Bounded list of authorized UIDs for shared space memories (max 20)

BorrowedItem.title: BorrowedItem
BorrowedItem.description: Tracker record for an item lent to or borrowed by someone

userId.description: UID of the owner tracking the lent item

borrowerName.description: Name of the person who borrowed the item

borrowerContact.description: Optional contact info or note for the borrower

notes.description: Optional notes about condition or context

borrowDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when item was borrowed

expectedReturnMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when item is expected to be returned

isReturned.description: Whether the item has been returned

returnedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when item was marked returned (0 if not returned)

SharedSpace.title: SharedSpace
SharedSpace.description: Collaborative memory space for family members or roommates

name.description: Display name of the shared space

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the shared space

memberNames.description: Bounded list of member display names (max 20)

invitedEmails.description: Bounded list of invited member email addresses (max 20)

SpaceInviteCode.title: SpaceInviteCode
SpaceInviteCode.description: Publicly resolvable invite code directory mapping a 6-character code to a SharedSpace ID without exposing PII

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private profile and notification settings

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: Private personal memories scoped to a single user

/users/{userId}/borrowed_items/{borrowId.description: Borrowed and lent items tracked by a user

/shared_spaces/{spaceId}.description: Shared memory spaces for families and roommates

/shared_spaces/{spaceId}/memories/{memor.description: Shared memories recorded inside a collaborative space

/space_codes/{inviteCode}.description: Lookup documents mapping 6-character invite codes to shared space IDs
